reviewType: Independent static review of unexecuted private wrapper
disposition: No actionable static blocker found within the assigned metadata-wrapper scope. This is not runtime qualification or approval of actual product outcomes.

checked.evidence: main parses optional --observe then PHASE22CWD and cmd as an argument list; Popen receives cmd unchanged. No shell, reporter injection, test selection rewrite, deadline flag or source restoration is added. shlex.join is metadata only.
checked.limit: Actual original argv and future command contents still require per-phase review.

checked.evidence: env=dict(os.environ), overriding PATH with Node22 prefix, HOME to the assigned private home, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 and only for observed commands the legacy AMC_P021_RUNTIME_OBSERVER_PATH.
checked.limit: Inherited environment is preserved; this is not a seven-key allowlist, credential-free, network-isolated or independent-dependency environment.

checked.evidence: Observed mode requires direct cmd[0] resolving to opt/node@22/bin/node, cmd[1] resolving to the assigned Vitest CLI, cmd[2]=run, one explicit exact frozen reporter and one JSON reporter. Frozen reporter digest is checked before launch.
checked.limit: This is resolver-path and reporter-byte validation, not an independent Node ABI/native load measurement. The reporter is reused unchanged and records run-end before global teardown.

checked.evidence: Popen uses start_new_session=True, records actual PID and observed PGID, then child.wait() without an added outer timeout. Normal exit must be0or1; observed PGID must be child PID or already gone.
checked.limit: An indefinitely hanging command remains blocked; no automatic kill or timeout cleanup is promised. Original test/helper deadlines are not modified.

checked.evidence: After normal leader exit, probes os.killpg(child.pid,0), retains each observation, polls at most5seconds/50ms and requires last absentByESRCH=true. Only errnoESRCH makes a positive absent fact. No terminating signals are sent.
checked.limit: The original owned group is measured; detached descendants, body completion and universal teardown health are not inferred.

checked.evidence: New phase directory required; phase names are constrained. ACTIVE uses exclusive creation; log, owned-process/group/command metadata use x; raw snapshot uses xb. ACTIVE/HALTED block future commands.
checked.limit: The command journal intentionally appends actual rows. Parent must prepare owned BASE/HOME/repository first; this review did not create them.

checked.evidence: Any BaseException after the ACTIVE marker preserves it and writes a new HALTED record when absent. No retry, terminating signal, generic cleanup or automatic source restoration occurs. ACTIVE removal happens only after normal process/group checks, head equality and command/journal writing.
checked.limit: Pre-launch validation failures before ACTIVE do not represent launched runtime. Root must not reinterpret retained incomplete artifacts as kills.

checked.evidence: Exactly one explicit outputFile[.json] argument must resolve to a fresh owned BASE destination outside home/store and reserved metadata. Vitest writes its original producer unchanged. Only after exit0/1 and owned-group absence does wrapper require a nonempty regular producer, require observer PID/cwd match, create raw.json exclusively and compare SHA256 of producer and snapshot.
checked.limit: The producer itself uses Vitest write semantics; wx applies to the separate snapshot. This is byte retention, not JSON/report correctness or assertion classification.

checked.evidence: Command row explicitly says process metadata only; raw/observer/late diagnostics require review. It records code1 rather than treating it as a pass/kill. Known late-close, hook/body, counts and semantic classification are deferred to the actual evidence audit.
checked.limit: No product success, mutation sensitivity, zero pending, source-preservation universe, whole process-tree cleanup or full gate follows from the wrapper alone.
